dimensions.assessment: Directly affects passenger train crew members, station personnel, and individuals who commit assaults or interference on passenger trains.
dimensions.evidence: The term `crew member' means any of the following employees: An engineer. A conductor. Onboard personnel.

dimensions.assessment: Subjects offenders to federal criminal penalties, including fines and imprisonment terms ranging up to 20 years for aggravated offenses.
dimensions.evidence: any person who violates subsection (b) shall be fined under title 18, imprisoned for not more than 6 months, or both... up to 20 years

importance_detail.rationale: The bill creates new federal criminal offenses and penalties for assaulting or intimidating passenger train crew members, aligning protections with those of aircraft crew members.
